Shandong Hande Diwangyuan 1583 Witbeer 4.8%
I purchased this because of the funny giant can which I then realised I couldn’t drink out of the can so here I am having a Chinese made German Witbeer out of a teacup in Vietnam. It’s actually pretty good. Just the right level of wheat. Refreshing and flavourful. 7.5/10

Enjoyed on the balcony of Sapa Hills Hotel and purchased for about $4.50

#🍺 #craftbeer #goodbeer #witbier #sapa
